headline: Man sentenced to death for murder of 5-year-old girl in Chattogram
summary: Abir Ali, a neighbor of the victim, was convicted for the 2022 killing of Alina Islam Ayat, whose body was chopped up and thrown into the sea.
details: A Chattogram court has sentenced a man to death for the 2022 murder of 5-year-old Alina Islam Ayat.
Chattogram Additional Metropolitan Sessions Judge Muhammad Ali Akkas delivered the verdict on Wednesday.
The victim, daughter of Sohel Rana, was a resident of the city's EPZ Thana area.
Alina was killed on November 14, 2022, after which her body was chopped up and thrown into the sea to hide the evidence.
Investigations revealed that the crime was committed by her neighbor, Abir Ali, who was sentenced to death by the court.
The verdict comes after a detailed investigation into the brutal murder of the child.
caption:

The victim, daughter of Sohel Rana, was a resident of the city's EPZ Thana area.

Alina was killed on November 14, 2022, after which her body was chopped up and thrown into the sea to hide the evidence.

Investigations revealed that the crime was committed by her neighbor, Abir Ali, who was sentenced to death by the court.

The verdict comes after a detailed investigation into the brutal murder of the child.

headline_marked: Tawhid Hridoy [[stands in as captain]] for Bangladesh in 1st T20I vs Australia
headline: Tawhid Hridoy stands in as captain for Bangladesh in 1st T20I vs Australia
summary: Hridoy won the toss and elected to bat first in the opening match of the series in Chattogram, as Litton Das missed the game.
details: Tawhid Hridoy took charge as the captain of the Bangladesh team for the first T20I against Australia on Wednesday.
The match took place in Chattogram, where Hridoy won the toss and decided to bat first.
The team composition saw Litton Das missing out on the game, leading to Hridoy's captaincy role.
The match also marked the debut of Sakline, adding a new face to the Tigers' lineup for the series opener.
caption:
New captain, new debutant! Tawhid Hridoy leads the Tigers against Australia in Chattogram.

Tawhid Hridoy took charge as the captain of the Bangladesh team for the first T20I against Australia on Wednesday.

The match took place in Chattogram, where Hridoy won the toss and decided to bat first.

The team composition saw Litton Das missing out on the game, leading to Hridoy's captaincy role.

The match also marked the debut of Sakline, adding a new face to the Tigers' lineup for the series opener.
